content: Fal Hyal A Dǝmǝlmau!
Ayukuɗa kau, tǝma, kǝ yi nggari vanyi ɗahǝ a papa ɗaha dlamir nju wau a dǝmǝlmau, a vǝr na,

content.text: Mbǝɗau ǝnga kadakadarkur ǝnga dǝnama a nggyari anǝ Hyalǝr mǝn,
arya jiri ǝnga tsatsaˈa ngǝ numa nyi.
A thlana nyir ja numa anǝ madiya zawar ta
ndǝra diyaɓǝna duniya ǝnga sǝsukur nyi.
A kibiyar ja ar ja mashi mafa nyi kǝra nji tsǝya.”

content: Wayu kǝ ndǝ ɓǝra wau, ndǝ na,

content.text: ˈYar kǝra a vǝr biya wu ja vǝr ɗǝzǝ a dǝmǝlmǝ baˈanuwa.”

content: Njira nggurǝm mǝthlǝkumunyi apǝ foɗǝu ǝnga sǝ ǝnga pi foɗǝ ta dla a gyu mwar Hyal ndu dlǝvǝ nyi, naja kǝra a vǝr nggya ar tsǝkafǝu. Ndu dzǝgwa tiwi, ndu na,
Kǝ ɗahǝ hyaˈari sara ar tsǝkafǝu, kǝ ji na,
Kǝ yi nggar vanyi ɗahǝ a papa ɗaha dlamir nji, ɗahǝ ǝnggǝr dǝl shida shida, ǝnggǝr ɗaha madiya dlǝɗǝr par, a vǝr wau,

content.text: Arya Hyal Thlagǝr mǝn Ndǝ Dǝgal Dǝnama a vǝr sǝm tǝlkur.
Taˈyi mǝna caguli mǝna ɗa ǝnga huɗǝ pipida
Arya hǝdzau nǝ Zǝr Gamǝ kau, a shiliri,
nga nji nǝ nyi aga ja hari.”

content: (Lilinu mbǝmbǝl camǝ ngǝ cabiya sǝr mǝla nji cici gǝ Hyal kǝra tsapǝu.)
Kǝ waladi kǝ nar ɗa, “Tsǝfǝya, ‘Barka anǝ njira nji nggǝya aga mini hǝdzǝ nǝ Zǝr Gamǝ kau!’ ” Ji ɓǝra cakǝri na, “Najakǝ ngǝ ndǝr Hyal kǝra jijiri.”

Ta yi nggari abangau, tǝma, kǝ yi dla a gyu huɗǝ nyi, aga ya dlǝvǝ nyi. Ama kǝ ji na anǝ ɗa, “A sara ga mǝl abangǝ mai! Ndǝ nga yi ǝnggǝr nagau, ndǝr mǝl thlǝr kuvwar ngau ba ǝnga zamǝr hyi kǝra lǝri sakida ar kǝra Yesu. Dlǝvǝ Hyal! Arya lǝri sakida ar kǝra Yesu ca ngǝ ndǝrhaha.”
Ndǝr Dlǝ Tagu Pǝrtǝu
Kǝ yi lari dǝmǝlmau papahau, ǝnga a dumwa ɗa vanyi tagu pǝrtǝu, kǝra ndǝr dla nyi nju ngga nyi ǝnga Ndǝra nju fǝr kǝr ni ǝnga Ndǝ jijiri. Ənga ju mǝl numa tsatsaˈa ǝnga pa tsatsaˈa.
Liya ja ǝnggǝr kyara uˈu. A du kǝra ja ngǝ dora nǝ tǝlkur gangǝu. Thlǝmǝ aˈyi kǝra tsǝtsǝfau ar ja, kǝra ndǝ gǝra sǝni kǝl naja.
Kar kǝra ar dza ja dzǝdzǝgu nga nyi ǝnga mashi. Thlǝmǝ nyi ca ngǝ Ndǝr Hyal.
Sojaˈyar kǝra a dǝmǝlmau a vǝr nu nyi, ar tagu pǝpǝrtǝu, ǝnga ndǝ hari lilinu pǝrtǝ camǝ mǝnahǝu.

Sara vu miya ja ngǝ vanyi katsakǝr sǝsǝm wu biya aga dliya duniya nǝ ˈyiˈyi pampamǝu. “Ju sǝm tǝlkur ǝnga zǝwa liyangǝu.” Ju nda ghighiraɓǝna vir ɓǝci ˈyimi wur inabi nǝ huɗǝ ndzǝndzǝ nǝ Hyal, Ndǝ Dǝgal Dǝnama.
Ar lǝgutǝ nyi ǝnga ar ˈya ja thlǝmǝ aˈyi tsǝtsǝfau:
Tǝl nǝ tǝlˈyar ǝnga Thlagǝ nǝ thlagǝˈyar.
Kǝ yi lari vanyi waladi taˈyi a dar pǝci, ju ngga ǝnga ɗahǝ dzǝdzǝgamǝ anǝ kalar ˈyagǝˈyar kǝra a vǝr mau, “Shila mau, hya kaɓiya dzǝ ǝnggau aga madiya sǝm sǝr sǝm nǝ Hyal.
Hya sa sǝm kumǝr dza tǝlˈyar ǝnga madiya sojaˈyar ǝnga madiya nji ǝnga taguˈyar ǝnga njir dlǝ nda ǝnga kumǝr nji patǝu, mafa ǝnga kambǝr nji, nji dǝdǝgal ǝnga nji kukushu.”
Kǝ yi lari sǝr tagǝ ta ǝnga tǝlˈyar nǝ duniya ǝnga njir par nda kaɓiya dzǝ aga pa ndǝr dlǝ tagu kau ǝnga soja nyiˈyar.

Ama kǝ ji mbari sǝr tagǝ kau ǝnga nabi fati kǝra a vǝr mǝl sǝ dǝdǝgur wu thlǝmǝ nyi. Ənga sǝ dǝdǝgur kǝra ji mǝl kau, ǝnga ji nggutana njira dlǝwuri mǝtsamǝ nǝ sǝr tagǝ kau, ǝnga ndǝ dlǝvǝ sǝra a papa nyi. Gyapǝ nda nga nji vakuwa a gu faˈa uˈur kǝtsa kǝra pǝrtǝ pwahǝu wu shuni ǝnga pi.
Alenyi njira hyau, kǝ ndǝr dlǝ tagu kau, tsǝya nda ǝnga katsakǝr kǝra wu biya sara wu miya ja. Patǝr ˈyagǝˈyar kaɓiya dzǝ aga nda sa nyabiya dzau ǝnga kumǝr dza nda.
